title: Glaucon
html_source:
Glaucon (c. 445 BC – 4th century BC) son of Ariston, was an ancient Athenian and the philosopher Plato’s older brother. He is primarily known as a major conversant with Socrates in the Republic, and the interlocutor during the Allegory of the Cave.
